title: NorthStar VC - Investor Profile
content: NorthStar VC led our Seed and Series A. Partner: Priya Sharma. Typically asks about net revenue retention, burn multiple and enterprise pipeline. Prefers concise monthly updates. Proposed Series B valuation cap is negotiable; our last internal target was a $120M post-money.

title: Board Notes - October 2026
content: Board priorities: reach $5M ARR by year-end, close Series B by mid-December, launch Enterprise tier by Nov 30. Concern raised about SSO delays and customer concentration (top 3 customers = 34% of revenue).

title: Competitor Intel - Q4 2026
content: Competitor Voltix launched an enterprise plan at 20% lower pricing and added SSO. Competitor Brightly raised $40M and is hiring aggressively in sales. Our differentiation: integrations depth and onboarding speed.

title: Acme Corp - Partnership Notes
content: Acme Corp is a mid-size workflow vendor with 4,000 customers overlapping our ICP. Prior contact in June stalled over API access. Potential integration could add ~$400K ARR in year one.

title: Incident Policy
content: Customer-impacting incidents over 30 minutes require a public postmortem within 5 business days and direct outreach to affected enterprise customers.
